title: Exception Handling with Try-Catch-Finally
ques: Explain the control flow of **`try`**, **`catch`**, and **`finally`** blocks. Write a function that safely parses potentially malformed JSON strings.
explanation: `try` wraps code that might fail. `catch` receives the thrown exception and prevents the program from crashing. `finally` executes unconditionally, ideal for cleanup actions.

title: Creating Custom Error Classes
ques: Demonstrate how to create a custom error class **`ValidationError`** that extends the built-in `Error` class and attaches an HTTP status code and field name.
explanation: Extending `Error` allows applications to differentiate business logic violations from system crashes via `instanceof`, carrying metadata like HTTP status codes and offending field names.

title: Modern JavaScript Debugging Techniques
ques: Explain effective JavaScript debugging techniques: `console.table()`, conditional breakpoints, and the **`debugger`** statement.
explanation: The `debugger` statement acts as a code-level breakpoint, pausing execution in browser DevTools or Node inspect mode so developers can inspect call stacks and variable scopes.
